title: Modern China in Flux
summary: This transformative volume bridges the rich texture of modern China's history with the innovative realm of network analysis, bringing forth a fresh perspective that captures the heartbeat of a nation in flux. By leveraging a trove of data from a wide range of historical sources and the latest digital tools, it presents a narrative that is both intricate and expansive, shedding light on China's societal, economic, and political intricacies.
